class Solution:
   def countDigitOccurrences(self, nums: list[int], digit: int) -> int:
       numbers_strings = map(str, nums)
       numbers_joined = "".join(numbers_strings)
       digit_string = str(digit)
       count = numbers_joined.count(digit_string)

       return count

class Solution:
    def convertTemperature(self, celsius: float) -> List[float]:
        ans = []
       
        kelvin = celsius + 273.15
        ans.append(kelvin)

        fahrenheit = celsius * 1.80 + 32.00
        ans.append(fahrenheit)

        return ans

class Solution:
    def leftRightDifference(self, nums: List[int]) -> List[int]:
        index = 0
        ans = []
        left_sum_a = []
        right_sum_a = []

        for i in range(len(nums)):
            left_sum = 0 if i == 0 else sum(nums[:i])
            right_sum = 0 if i == len(nums) - 1 else sum(nums[i+1:])
            left_sum_a.append(left_sum)
            right_sum_a.append(right_sum)

        for i in range(len(left_sum_a)):
            ans.append(abs(left_sum_a[i] - right_sum_a[i]))

        return ans
